title: IPL 2026 Points Table Update: Rajasthan Royals Jump to No. 2 After Win Over Lucknow, Punjab Kings Stay Unbeaten
text:
Lucknow, India — April 23, 2026
The Indian Premier League 2026 points table saw a major shake-up after Rajasthan Royals secured a crucial victory over Lucknow Super Giants, climbing to second place in the standings.
With this win, Rajasthan now has 10 points from 7 matches, having won five games. Their strong net run rate of +0.790 further strengthens their playoff position.
Meanwhile, Lucknow’s struggles continue. The team has now lost five of its seven matches and remains in ninth place with just 4 points and a concerning net run rate of -1.277.
🏏 Punjab Kings Dominate at the Top
Punjab Kings continue to lead the table and remain the only unbeaten side in the tournament so far. With 11 points from 6 matches and an impressive +1.420 net run rate, they are setting the pace in IPL 2026.
📊 Mid-Table Battle Intensifies
Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Sunrisers Hyderabad occupy the third and fourth spots respectively, both with 8 points. Their strong performances keep them firmly in playoff contention.
Delhi Capitals and Gujarat Titans sit mid-table with 6 points each, while Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings are struggling to gain momentum with just 4 points each.
📉 Bottom Teams Under Pressure
At the lower end, Lucknow Super Giants and Kolkata Knight Riders face increasing pressure to turn their campaigns around, with both teams trailing significantly in points and net run rate.
📋 IPL 2026 Points Table (Updated)
| Team | Matches | Won | Lost | Points | Net Run Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Punjab Kings | 6 | 5 | 0 | 11 | +1.420 |
| Rajasthan Royals | 7 | 5 | 2 | 10 | +0.790 |
| Royal Challengers Bengaluru | 6 | 4 | 2 | 8 | +1.171 |
| Sunrisers Hyderabad | 7 | 4 | 3 | 8 | +0.820 |
| Delhi Capitals | 6 | 3 | 3 | 6 | -0.130 |
| Gujarat Titans | 6 | 3 | 3 | 6 | -0.821 |
| Mumbai Indians | 6 | 2 | 4 | 4 | +0.067 |
| Chennai Super Kings | 6 | 2 | 4 | 4 | -0.780 |
| Lucknow Super Giants | 7 | 2 | 5 | 4 | -1.277 |
| Kolkata Knight Riders | 7 | 1 | 5 | 3 | -0.879 |
📊 Match Impact & Analysis
Rajasthan’s rise to second highlights their consistency this season, especially in high-pressure matches. Their balanced squad and strong net run rate could prove decisive in the playoff race.
On the other hand, Lucknow’s campaign is slipping, with back-to-back losses impacting both confidence and standings. Their negative net run rate further complicates their path forward.
🔍 What’s Next?
As IPL 2026 progresses, the race for playoff spots is heating up. With teams closely packed in the middle of the table, every match could significantly alter the standings.
